full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media digital painting shows a bowed young man in formal dark clothing against a worn beige-gray ground. The background is divided into broad vertical fields: a darker textured band on the left, a pale central strip, and a warm off-white area on the right. Transparent triangles and rectangles slide across these fields, their straight edges cutting through both the setting and the man's body. The man's upper torso occupies the lower half, his face and swept-back dark hair rising through the center-left. His head tilts down toward the right, and the eyes disappear under a heavy shadow extending across the brow. A pale ear remains clear on the left side; the long nose, shut mouth, and angular cheek are modeled in cool gray and muted skin tones. He wears a dark jacket over a pale collar and narrow neckwear, although parts of the garment are interrupted by overlaid translucent planes. A sharp black wedge covers much of the right side of his face and neck. Across the lower left, a large light triangular area crosses his shoulder and presses into the dark jacket. Near the right edge, a tall narrow pale field masks the outside of his shoulder, leaving the body to fade into the surface. The geometric pieces are not separate objects in space; they act as transparent cuts and shifts in value, making the figure appear fragmented yet still readable. Soft illumination falls from the upper left, brightening the forehead and ear while the right eye and jaw recede into a dark plane. Fine scratches, dusty grain, and faint vertical streaks give the whole image the feel of aged print or worn paint. The overall composition is quiet and severe, balancing a recognizable figure with flat overlapping geometry and restrained gray-green color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介数字绘画呈现一位低头的年轻男子，穿深色正式服装，背后是磨旧的米灰色底面。背景分成宽阔竖向色域：左侧较暗的纹理带、中央浅色条带和右侧暖灰白区域。半透明三角形与长方形滑过这些色域，笔直边缘同时切入环境与男子身体。男子上身占据下半幅，面孔和向后梳的深色头发升至中间偏左。头向右下倾斜，双眼消失在横过眉部的重影下。左侧一只浅色耳朵仍很清楚；长鼻、闭合的嘴和棱角分明的面颊以冷灰与低调肤色塑形。他在浅色领口和狭窄颈饰外穿深色外套，但部分衣物被叠加的半透明平面切断。一块锐利的黑色楔形覆盖脸和颈的右侧大部分。左下方，一大块浅色三角区域横过肩膀，压进深色外套。靠近右缘，一道高而窄的浅色区域遮住肩部外沿，使身体淡入底面。这些几何片并非空间里的独立物件，而是透明的切割和明度位移，让人物看似碎裂却仍可辨认。柔光从左上落下，照亮额头与耳朵，右眼和下颌则退入深色平面。细微划痕、灰尘状颗粒和隐约竖向条痕让整幅画具有老旧印刷品或磨损颜料的触感。整体构图安静而严厉，在可辨的人物、平面叠置的几何结构与克制的灰绿色之间取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media surface combines softly modeled grayscale volume with translucent geometric overlays and weathered print texture. Vertical strips and broad angled planes cross one another, shifting the value of underlying forms without erasing them completely. A restrained range of warm off-white, cool gray-green, charcoal, and small earthy accents keeps the fragmentation coherent. Some edges are blade-straight and abrupt; others dissolve through grain, scratches, and soft tonal blending. The darkest wedge concentrates visual weight near the center, while paler bands open breathing room around it. Gentle light from one side gives rounded areas a subdued sense of mass, yet the overlays keep the image close to a shallow graphic plane. Faint streaks and uneven pigment make the surface feel handled and aged. The overall effect is contemplative and slightly dislocated, with tension between continuous volume and precise planar interruption.
style_prompt_zh: 混合媒介表面把柔和塑形的灰阶体积、半透明几何叠层与风化印刷肌理结合起来。竖向条带与宽阔斜面互相穿过，改变下层形体的明度，却没有将其完全擦去。暖灰白、冷灰绿、炭黑和少量土色重音构成克制色域，让碎片化结构保持统一。有些边缘如刀切般笔直突兀，另一些则通过颗粒、划痕和柔和明度融合而消散。最暗的楔形在中央附近集中视觉重量，较浅色带在外围打开呼吸空间。一侧的柔光赋予圆润区域低调体积感，叠层却让图像保持接近浅平面的图形性。隐约条痕和不均匀颜料使表面显得被触碰、被磨旧。整体效果沉思而略带错位感，张力来自连续体积与精确平面切割之间。
theme_en: A bowed male figure segmented by translucent geometric planes
theme_zh: 低头男子被半透明几何平面分割的画面
name: John Reuss
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
